method.name: findIssues
method.purpose: Lists every issue, open or closed, that carries all the given labels, in ascending issue-number order, so a creator can tell whether another issue for the same unit exists and keep the lowest.

body.rationale: findIssue returns only the first match and gh lists newest first, so two daemons that each created an issue for a unit cannot both reach the same answer. A listing lets every daemon keep the lowest-numbered issue and close its own, which converges concurrent creators without coordination. The method is additive and the sc1 sketch is otherwise unchanged.
